# Generic example: safely find latest approved request and refund
from appworld.common.finders import find_one_from_pages

def refund_with_fallback(person_name):
    profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
    pws = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
    ptoken = apis.phone.login(username=profile.username, password=pws.phone)
    vtoken = apis.venmo.login(username=profile.username, password=pws.venmo)
    # try to find contact by first name, fallback to full name
    contact = None
    for query in [person_name.split()[0], person_name]:
        results = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=ptoken, query=query)
        if results:
            contact = results[0]
            break
    if not contact:
        raise RuntimeError("Contact not found")
    email = contact.email
    requests = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=vtoken, status='approved')
    approved_to = [r for r in requests if r.receiver.email == email]
    if not approved_to:
        all_requests = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=vtoken)
        approved_to = [r for r in all_requests if r.receiver.email == email and r.status in ('approved', 'completed')]
    latest = max(approved_to, key=lambda r: r.created_at)
    apis.venmo.create_transaction(access_token=vtoken, receiver_email=email, amount=latest.amount, description='Returning accidental payment')
    apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=None, status='success')
